joel.3.p1.b1.text: Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity, I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them

joel.3.p1.b2.text: … whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.

joel.3.p1.b3.text: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? …

joel.3.p1.b4.text: For you took My silver and gold … You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.

joel.3.p1.b5.text: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.

joel.3.p2.b1.text: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!

joel.3.p2.b2.text: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’

joel.3.p2.b3.text: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.

joel.3.p2.b4.text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.

joel.3.p2.b5.text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

joel.3.p2.b6.text: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine. The LORD will roar from Zion … But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

joel.3.p3.b1.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.

joel.3.p3.b2.text: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.

joel.3.p3.b3.text: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

joel.3.p3.b4.text: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

joel.3.p3.b5.text: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged.” For the LORD dwells in Zion.
